protocols.name: 10× PBS

instructions.zh: 用 ddH₂O 定容，HCl 调 pH 至 7.4。高压灭菌后室温保存。使用前稀释至 1× (1:10)。
instructions.en: Bring to volume with ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl. Autoclave and store at RT. Dilute 1:10 to prepare 1× PBS.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

protocols.name: 1× PBS

instructions.zh: 用 ddH₂O 定容至 1000 mL，调 pH 至 7.4。或由 10× PBS 稀释。
instructions.en: Bring to 1000 mL with ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.4. Alternatively, dilute from 10× PBS stock.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

protocols.name: 10× TBS

instructions.zh: 溶于约 800 mL ddH₂O，用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.6，再定容至 1000 mL。
instructions.en: Dissolve in ~800 mL ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.6 with HCl, then bring to 1000 mL.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

protocols.name: 1× TBST

instructions.zh: 现配现用。Tween-20 终浓度 0.05–0.1% 均可，根据背景调整。
instructions.en: Prepare fresh. Tween-20 at 0.05–0.1% is acceptable; adjust based on background signal.

protocols.reference: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

protocols.name: RIPA Lysis Buffer

instructions.zh: 使用前加入蛋白酶抑制剂 cocktail (1:100) 和磷酸酶抑制剂。冰上操作，4°C 保存。
instructions.en: Add protease inhibitor cocktail (1:100) and phosphatase inhibitors before use. Work on ice, store at 4°C.

protocols.reference: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40; Abcam RIPA Buffer Recipe

protocols.name: 2× Laemmli Sample Buffer

instructions.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存。β-mercaptoethanol 可用 DTT (200 mM) 替代。使用前 95–100°C 加热 5 min。
instructions.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C. β-mercaptoethanol can be replaced with DTT (200 mM). Heat at 95–100°C for 5 min before loading.

protocols.reference: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

protocols.name: 4× Laemmli Sample Buffer

instructions.zh: 分装保存 -20°C。上样时 1:4 稀释（样品:buffer = 3:1）。
instructions.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C. Dilute 1:4 before use (3 parts sample : 1 part buffer).

protocols.reference: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

protocols.name: 1× Running Buffer (Tris-Glycine-SDS)

instructions.zh: pH 应自然达到 ~8.3，无需调 pH。也可由 10× 母液稀释。
instructions.en: pH should naturally reach ~8.3; no adjustment needed. Can also dilute from 10× stock.

protocols.reference: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685; Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10

protocols.name: 10× Running Buffer

instructions.zh: 溶于 ddH₂O 定容至 1 L。不需调 pH。室温保存。使用前 1:10 稀释。
instructions.en: Dissolve in ddH₂O, bring to 1 L. No pH adjustment needed. Store at RT. Dilute 1:10 before use.

protocols.reference: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

protocols.name: 1× Transfer Buffer (Towbin)

instructions.zh: 加入甲醇后定容至 1 L。转膜大蛋白 (>100 kDa) 可加 0.01–0.05% SDS。4°C 使用。不要调 pH。
instructions.en: Add methanol last, bring to 1 L. For proteins >100 kDa, add 0.01–0.05% SDS. Use cold (4°C). Do not adjust pH.

protocols.reference: Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350–4354

protocols.name: 5% Skim Milk Blocking Buffer

instructions.zh: 现配现用。勿用于检测磷酸化蛋白（milk 中含酪蛋白磷酸化位点），改用 BSA。
instructions.en: Prepare fresh. Do not use for phospho-protein detection (milk casein is phosphorylated). Use BSA blocking instead.

protocols.reference: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

protocols.name: 5% BSA Blocking Buffer

instructions.zh: 适用于磷酸化蛋白检测。加 0.02% NaN₃ 可 4°C 保存约 1 周。
instructions.en: Suitable for phospho-protein detection. Add 0.02% NaN₃ to store at 4°C for ~1 week.

protocols.reference: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10, Unit 10.2A

protocols.name: 50× TAE

instructions.zh: 50× 母液。先溶 Tris，加冰醋酸和 EDTA，定容至 1 L。使用前稀释至 1× (20 mL → 1 L)。工作浓度：1× = 40 mM Tris-acetate, 1 mM EDTA。从凝胶回收 DNA 时优于 TBE。
instructions.en: Dissolve Tris first, add acetic acid and EDTA, bring to 1 L. Dilute to 1× (20 mL → 1 L) before use.

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8644; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

protocols.name: 10× TBE

instructions.zh: 分辨率要求高时用 TBE (优于 TAE)。稀释至 0.5× 或 1× 使用。0.5× = 45 mM Tris-borate, 1 mM EDTA, pH ~8.3。室温保存，过 0.22 µm 滤膜防沉淀。
instructions.en: Provides higher resolution than TAE for certain applications. Use at 0.5× or 1×.

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8458; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

protocols.name: TE Buffer

instructions.zh: 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0。DNA 保存标准缓冲液。EDTA 螯合二价阳离子抑制核酸酶。高压灭菌，室温保存。低 TE (0.1 mM EDTA) 适合 PCR 模板。
instructions.en: Used for dissolving and storing DNA. Autoclave before storage. Low TE (0.1 mM EDTA) is suitable for PCR templates.

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

protocols.name: Coomassie Blue Staining Solution

instructions.zh: 先将 CBB 溶于甲醇，再加醋酸和水。使用前过滤 (0.45 µm)。染色 1–4 h。
instructions.en: Dissolve CBB in methanol first, then add acetic acid and water. Filter (0.45 µm) before use. Stain 1–4 h.

protocols.reference: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol, Ch.10, Unit 10.6

protocols.name: Coomassie Destaining Solution

instructions.zh: 多次换液，加 Kimwipe 吸附可加速脱色。
instructions.en: Change destain solution multiple times; adding Kimwipes absorbs released dye and speeds destaining.

protocols.reference: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol, Ch.10

protocols.name: Ponceau S Staining Solution

instructions.zh: 转膜后浸泡 PVDF/NC 膜 1–5 min，TBS 或水洗即可脱色。可重复使用。
instructions.en: Soak PVDF/NC membrane for 1–5 min after transfer. Rinse with TBS or water to destain. Solution is reusable.

protocols.reference: Romero-Calvo et al. (2010) Anal Biochem 401:318–320

protocols.name: LB Medium (Luria-Bertani)

instructions.zh: 溶于 ddH₂O，调 pH 至 7.0，定容。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min。冷却后加抗生素。
instructions.en: Dissolve in ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.0, bring to volume. Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min. Cool before adding antibiotics.

protocols.reference: Bertani (1951) J Bacteriol 62:293–300; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

protocols.name: LB Agar

instructions.zh: 高压灭菌后冷至 ~55°C 加抗生素，倒板。每板约 25 mL (100 mm dish)。
instructions.en: Autoclave, cool to ~55°C before adding antibiotics, then pour plates. ~25 mL per 100 mm dish.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

protocols.name: SOC Medium

instructions.zh: 灭菌前加 Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl。灭菌后冷却至 <60°C 加 MgCl₂ 和 Glucose。分装 -20°C。
instructions.en: Autoclave Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl together. After cooling to <60°C, add sterile MgCl₂ and filter-sterilized glucose. Aliquot at −20°C.

protocols.reference: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580

protocols.name: WB Stripping Buffer (Mild)

instructions.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 2.2。37°C 孵育 10–15 min × 2 次，然后 TBST 洗 3 次 × 10 min，重新封闭。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 2.2 with HCl. Incubate at 37°C for 10–15 min × 2, then wash with TBST 3 × 10 min, then re-block.

protocols.reference: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

protocols.name: IP / Co-IP Lysis Buffer

instructions.zh: 使用前加蛋白酶/磷酸酶抑制剂。Co-IP 用温和去垢剂 (0.5% NP-40) 保持蛋白互作。冰上裂解 30 min，4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min。
instructions.en: Add protease/phosphatase inhibitors before use. For Co-IP use mild detergent (0.5% NP-40) to preserve interactions. Lyse on ice 30 min, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 15 min.

protocols.reference: Miernyk & Thelen (2008) Plant J 55:415–425; Nature Protocols

protocols.name: ChIP SDS Lysis Buffer

instructions.zh: 交联后 (1% 甲醛，室温 10 min) 使用。加蛋白酶抑制剂。超声使 DNA 片段 200–500 bp。
instructions.en: Use after crosslinking (1% formaldehyde, RT 10 min). Add protease inhibitors. Sonicate to generate 200–500 bp DNA fragments.

protocols.reference: Lee et al. (2006) Cell 125:301–313; Collas (2010) Mol Biotechnol 45:87–100

protocols.name: ChIP Dilution Buffer

instructions.zh: 将 SDS 裂解产物稀释 10× 后用于免疫沉淀。加蛋白酶抑制剂。
instructions.en: Dilute SDS lysate 10× with this buffer before immunoprecipitation. Add protease inhibitors.

protocols.reference: Upstate/Millipore ChIP Protocol; Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

protocols.name: ChIP Low Salt Wash Buffer

instructions.zh: ChIP 洗涤步骤，每步 4°C 旋转 5 min。
instructions.en: ChIP wash step; rotate at 4°C for 5 min each wash.

protocols.reference: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

protocols.name: ChIP High Salt Wash Buffer

instructions.zh: 高盐洗涤减少非特异性结合。
instructions.en: High-salt wash reduces nonspecific binding.

protocols.reference: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

protocols.name: 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA)

instructions.zh: 60°C 水浴搅拌溶解 (勿超 70°C)，加 NaOH 至澄清，冷却后调 pH 至 7.4。过滤 (0.45 µm)。分装 -20°C 保存。⚠️ 通风橱操作！
instructions.en: 60°C water bath to dissolve (do not exceed 70°C); add NaOH to clarify; cool and adjust pH to 7.4. Filter (0.45 µm). Aliquot at −20°C.

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec11863; Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

protocols.name: IF Permeabilization Buffer

instructions.zh: 室温孵育 10–15 min。胞膜蛋白用 0.05% Triton 或 0.1% saponin。核蛋白可用 0.5% Triton。
instructions.en: Incubate at RT 10–15 min. For membrane proteins use 0.05% Triton or 0.1% saponin. For nuclear proteins use 0.5% Triton.

protocols.reference: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.7; Nature Protocols

protocols.name: IF Blocking Buffer

instructions.zh: 封闭 1 h 室温。serum 种属应与二抗宿主一致。也可用 10% donkey serum。
instructions.en: Block 1 h at RT. Serum species should match the secondary antibody host. 10% donkey serum also works.

protocols.reference: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1; Im et al. (2019) STAR Protoc Preview

protocols.name: FACS Staining Buffer

instructions.zh: NaN₃ 防止 cap-and-strip；若做活细胞分选则不加 NaN₃。4°C 保存。过滤 (0.22 µm)。
instructions.en: Include NaN₃ to prevent capping; omit for live cell sorting. Store at 4°C. Filter through 0.22 µm.

protocols.reference: Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457–1973 (Guidelines for flow cytometry)

protocols.name: MACS Separation Buffer

instructions.zh: 脱气后使用。4°C 保存。也可用 FBS 替代 BSA (2% FBS)。
instructions.en: Degas before use. Store at 4°C. 2% FBS can substitute BSA.

protocols.reference: Miltenyi Biotec MACS Handbook; Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457

protocols.name: Nuclear/Cytoplasmic Fractionation Buffer A
protocols.nameZh: 核质分离裂解液 A (胞浆)

instructions.zh: 冰上孵育 15 min，加 10% NP-40 至终浓度 0.6%，涡旋 10 s，4°C 14,000×g 30 s。上清 = 胞浆。
instructions.en: Incubate on ice 15 min, add 10% NP-40 to final 0.6%, vortex 10 s, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 30 s. Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction.

protocols.reference: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29; Suzuki et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:532–539

protocols.name: Nuclear/Cytoplasmic Fractionation Buffer B
protocols.nameZh: 核质分离裂解液 B (核)

instructions.zh: 重悬核沉淀，冰上振荡 15 min，4°C 14,000×g 5 min。上清 = 核蛋白。加蛋白酶抑制剂。
instructions.en: Resuspend nuclear pellet, rock on ice 15 min, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 5 min. Supernatant = nuclear extract. Add protease inhibitors.

protocols.reference: Suzuki et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:532–539

protocols.name: His-tag Binding/Wash Buffer

instructions.zh: NaOH 调 pH 至 8.0。结合液含 10–20 mM imidazole；洗涤液 20–50 mM；洗脱液 250–500 mM。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH. Binding buffer: 10–20 mM imidazole; wash buffer: 20–50 mM; elution buffer: 250–500 mM.

protocols.reference: QIAGEN Ni-NTA Handbook; Kimple et al. (2013) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 73:9.9.1–9.9.23

protocols.name: His-tag Elution Buffer

instructions.zh: 调 pH 至 8.0。洗脱后立即透析或脱盐去除 imidazole。可用梯度洗脱提高纯度。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 8.0. Dialyze or desalt immediately after elution to remove imidazole. Gradient elution improves purity.

protocols.reference: QIAGEN Ni-NTA Handbook; Kimple et al. (2013) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 73:9.9.1

protocols.name: GST Elution Buffer

instructions.zh: 新鲜配制。谷胱甘肽易氧化，临用加入。调 pH 至 8.0。室温洗脱 10–15 min。
instructions.en: Prepare fresh — glutathione oxidizes rapidly. Add just before use. Adjust pH to 8.0. Elute at RT for 10–15 min.

protocols.reference: Harper & Bhatt (2004) Methods Mol Biol 261:55–72; GE Healthcare GST Gene Fusion System Handbook

protocols.name: Native PAGE Running Buffer
protocols.nameZh: 非变性 PAGE 电泳缓冲液

instructions.zh: 与 SDS-PAGE 相同但不加 SDS。pH ~8.3 自然形成。样品不煮沸不加还原剂。4°C 电泳。
instructions.en: Same as SDS-PAGE but without SDS. pH ~8.3 forms naturally. Do not boil samples or add reducing agents. Run at 4°C.

protocols.reference: Wittig et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:418–428

protocols.name: Blue Native PAGE Cathode Buffer

instructions.zh: 不调 pH (约 7.0)。电泳 1/3 后可换不含 CBB 的阴极缓冲液。
instructions.en: Do not adjust pH (~7.0). After the gel front has migrated ~1/3, switch to cathode buffer without CBB to reduce background.

protocols.reference: Wittig et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:418–428

protocols.name: MTT Stock Solution

instructions.zh: 过滤除菌 (0.22 µm)。分装 -20°C 避光保存。使用时每孔加 10 µL/100 µL 培养基。37°C 4 h 后弃上清，加 DMSO 150 µL 溶解紫色结晶。490–570 nm 读数。
instructions.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light. Add 10 µL per 100 µL medium. After 37°C 4 h incubation, discard supernatant and solubilize formazan.

protocols.reference: Mosmann (1983) J Immunol Methods 65:55–63; van Meerloo et al. (2011) Methods Mol Biol 731:237–245

protocols.name: CRISPR RNP Assembly Buffer

instructions.zh: sgRNA:Cas9 摩尔比 1.2:1–3:1。室温孵育 10 min 组装 RNP。电转或脂质体转染。
instructions.en: sgRNA:Cas9 molar ratio 1.2:1–3:1. Incubate at RT for 10 min to assemble RNP complex. Deliver by electroporation or lipofection.

protocols.reference: Kim et al. (2014) Genome Res 24:1012–1019; Hanna & Doench (2020) Nat Biotechnol 38:824–844

protocols.name: TRIzol RNA Extraction (Protocol)

instructions.zh: 流程: TRIzol 裂解 → 加氯仿，震荡 15 s → 室温 3 min → 4°C 12,000×g 15 min → 取上层水相 → 加异丙醇 → 室温 10 min → 4°C 12,000×g 10 min → 弃上清 → 75% 乙醇洗 → 风干 → 溶解。OD260/280 ≈ 2.0 为佳。
instructions.en: Protocol: TRIzol lysis → add chloroform, shake 15 s → 3 min RT → 4°C 12,000×g 15 min → collect upper aqueous phase → isopropanol precipitation.

protocols.reference: Chomczynski & Sacchi (1987) Anal Biochem 162:156–159; Rio et al. (2010) CSH Protoc doi:10.1101/pdb.prot5439

protocols.name: Western Blot Full Protocol

components.name: 1. 样品制备: RIPA 裂解
3. 加 Loading Buffer, 煮沸 5 min

instructions.zh: 一抗稀释比通常 1:500–1:2000；HRP 二抗 1:5000–1:10000。磷酸化蛋白用 BSA 封闭。半干转适合 <100 kDa 蛋白。PVDF 需甲醇活化。
instructions.en: Primary antibody: 1:500–1:2000; HRP secondary: 1:5000–1:10000. Use BSA blocking for phospho-proteins. Semi-dry transfer suitable for proteins <100 kDa.

protocols.reference: Mahmood & Yang (2012) N Am J Med Sci 4:429–434; Bass et al. (2017) STAR Protoc Preview; Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350

usage.en: Detect specific proteins in cell/tissue lysates by separating on SDS-PAGE, transferring to membrane, and probing with antibodies. Quantitative with proper controls.
usage.zh: 通过 SDS-PAGE 分离蛋白，转膜后用抗体探测特定蛋白。适当对照下可实现定量分析。

briefSteps.en: Lyse → quantify → SDS-PAGE → transfer → block → primary Ab O/N → wash → secondary Ab 1h → wash → ECL detect
briefSteps.zh: 裂解 → 定量 → SDS-PAGE → 转膜 → 封闭 → 一抗过夜 → 洗 → 二抗 1h → 洗 → ECL 检测

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Sample prep**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 样品制备**

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Aspirate media, wash 1× cold PBS. Add cold RIPA buffer (100–200 µL per well of 6-well plate). Rock on ice 15–30 min
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 吸除培养基，冷 PBS 洗 1 次。加冷 RIPA 裂解液（6 孔板每孔 100–200 µL）。冰上晃动 15–30 min

detailedSteps.en: Scrape cells, transfer to 1.5 mL tube. Centrifuge 14,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant (= total protein)
detailedSteps.zh: 刮下细胞，转移至 1.5 mL 管。4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min。取上清（= 总蛋白）

detailedSteps.en: **Quantification**: BCA or Bradford assay. Need 20–50 µg protein per lane
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: BCA 或 Bradford 法。每泳道需 20–50 µg 蛋白

detailedSteps.en: Mix protein sample with equal volume 2× Laemmli buffer (or 1:3 with 4× buffer)
detailedSteps.zh: 蛋白样品与等体积 2× Laemmli buffer 混合（或与 4× buffer 1:3 混合）

detailedSteps.en: Boil 95°C, 5 min (or 70°C, 10 min for membrane proteins). Quick-spin, place on ice or store -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: 95°C 煮沸 5 min（膜蛋白用 70°C, 10 min）。快速离心，冰上或 -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **SDS-PAGE**: Set up gel (choose % based on target MW — see Gel Calculator tab). Load samples + ladder
detailedSteps.zh: **SDS-PAGE**: 装好凝胶（根据目标蛋白分子量选择浓度——参见配胶计算 tab）。上样 + Marker

detailedSteps.en: Run: 80V through stacking gel (~20 min), then 120V through resolving gel (~1–1.5 h). Run until dye front reaches bottom
detailedSteps.zh: 电泳: 浓缩胶 80V（约 20 min），分离胶 120V（约 1–1.5 h）。跑至溴酚蓝到达底部

detailedSteps.en: **Transfer**: Prepare transfer sandwich — sponge / filter paper / gel / membrane / filter paper / sponge. Remove all air bubbles!
detailedSteps.zh: **转膜**: 组装转膜三明治——海绵 / 滤纸 / 凝胶 / 膜 / 滤纸 / 海绵。去除所有气泡！

detailedSteps.en: Wet transfer: 100V, 60–90 min in cold Transfer Buffer with ice pack. OR semi-dry: 25V, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 湿转: 冷 Transfer Buffer 中 100V, 60–90 min，加冰块。或半干转: 25V, 30 min

detailedSteps.en: For proteins >150 kDa: transfer at 30V overnight at 4°C, reduce methanol to 10%, add 0.01% SDS
detailedSteps.zh: >150 kDa 蛋白: 4°C 30V 过夜转膜，甲醇降至 10%，加 0.01% SDS

detailedSteps.en: **Verify transfer**: Ponceau S stain membrane 2 min, wash with ddH₂O. Photograph. Destain with TBST
detailedSteps.zh: **验证转膜**: Ponceau S 染膜 2 min，ddH₂O 冲洗。拍照。用 TBST 脱色

detailedSteps.en: **Blocking**: 5% milk/TBST or 5% BSA/TBST, 1 h at RT with rocking. ⚠️ Use BSA for phospho-antibodies!
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 5% 脱脂奶/TBST 或 5% BSA/TBST，室温摇 1 h。⚠️ 磷酸化抗体必须用 BSA！

detailedSteps.en: **Primary antibody**: Dilute in blocking buffer (typically 1:500–1:2000). Incubate 4°C overnight with rocking
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗**: 用封闭液稀释（通常 1:500–1:2000）。4°C 摇孵过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: TBST 3×10 min with rocking. Use generous volume (>10 mL per wash)
detailedSteps.zh: **洗膜**: TBST 3×10 min 摇洗。用量要足（每次 >10 mL）

detailedSteps.en: **Secondary antibody**: HRP-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit IgG, dilute 1:5000–1:10,000 in blocking buffer. 1 h RT
detailedSteps.zh: **二抗**: HRP 标记的抗鼠/兔 IgG，封闭液 1:5000–1:10,000 稀释。室温 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: TBST 3×10 min. Final wash with TBS (no Tween) 1×5 min
detailedSteps.zh: **洗膜**: TBST 3×10 min。最后用 TBS（不含 Tween）洗 1×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Detection**: Mix ECL components 1:1, apply to membrane, incubate 1–5 min. Image on ChemiDoc or expose to film
detailedSteps.zh: **检测**: ECL 等比混合，涂于膜上，孵育 1–5 min。用化学发光成像仪或胶片曝光

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: Quantify band intensity with ImageJ/Image Lab. Normalize to loading control (β-actin, GAPDH, or total protein)
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: 用 ImageJ/Image Lab 定量条带灰度。以 loading control（β-actin、GAPDH 或总蛋白）归一化

protocols.name: Immunofluorescence (IF) Protocol

components.name: 7. 封闭 (3% BSA + 5% serum) 1 h RT
8. 一抗 (稀释于封闭液) 4°C 过夜
10. 荧光二抗 1 h RT 避光

instructions.zh: 二抗选择: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647 等。避光操作。组织切片需抗原修复 (热修复或酶消化)。共聚焦推荐 63× oil 物镜。
instructions.en: Secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647. Protect from light. Tissue sections require antigen retrieval (heat-induced or enzymatic). Confocal: recommend 63× oil immersion.

protocols.reference: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1; Im et al. (2019) STAR Protoc 1:100023; CSH Protocols

label.zh: 实验方案 — 当天完成（~5h + 过夜）

usage.en: Visualize protein localization and expression in fixed cells using fluorescent antibodies. Compatible with confocal, epifluorescence, and super-resolution microscopy.
usage.zh: 用荧光抗体观察固定细胞中蛋白的定位和表达。兼容共聚焦、落射荧光和超分辨率显微镜。

briefSteps.en: Culture on coverslips → fix (PFA) → permeabilize → block → primary Ab O/N → wash → fluorescent secondary 1h → DAPI → mount
briefSteps.zh: 盖玻片培养 → 固定 (PFA) → 透化 → 封闭 → 一抗过夜 → 洗 → 荧光二抗 1h → DAPI → 封片

detailedSteps.en: **Cell preparation**: Seed cells on sterile coverslips in 24-well plate (or chamber slides). Culture to 50–70% confluency
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞准备**: 将无菌盖玻片放入 24 孔板（或使用 chamber slides）。培养至 50–70% 汇合度

detailedSteps.en: For suspension cells: use poly-L-lysine coated coverslips or cytospin onto slides
detailedSteps.zh: 悬浮细胞：使用多聚赖氨酸包被的盖玻片或 cytospin 到载玻片上

detailedSteps.en: **Fixation**: Aspirate media, wash 2× with RT PBS (gentle!). Add 4% PFA, 15 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **固定**: 吸除培养基，室温 PBS 轻柔洗 2 次。加 4% PFA，室温固定 15 min

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Do NOT fix >20 min — over-fixation masks epitopes. For some antigens, try ice-cold methanol 10 min instead
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 不要固定 >20 min——过度固定会遮蔽表位。某些抗原可改用冰冷甲醇固定 10 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Permeabilization**: 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 / PBS, 10 min RT. (Membrane proteins: skip this step or use 0.05%)
detailedSteps.zh: **透化**: 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 / PBS，室温 10 min（膜蛋白：跳过此步或用 0.05%）

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Blocking**: 3% BSA + 5% normal serum (same species as secondary Ab) in PBS-T, 1 h RT
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 3% BSA + 5% 正常血清（与二抗同种属）溶于 PBS-T，室温 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Primary antibody**: Dilute in blocking buffer (typically 1:50–1:500). Apply 200 µL per coverslip. 4°C overnight in humidified chamber
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗**: 用封闭液稀释（通常 1:50–1:500）。每片加 200 µL。4°C 湿盒过夜

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Lay parafilm in dish + wet paper towel to make humidity chamber. Place coverslips cell-side DOWN on antibody drops
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 用保鲜膜铺在培养皿中 + 湿纸巾做湿盒。盖玻片细胞面朝下放在抗体液滴上

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS (from here on, protect from light!)
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min（从此步起避光操作！）

detailedSteps.en: **Secondary antibody**: Fluorescent-conjugated (Alexa Fluor 488/555/647), 1:200–1:1000 in blocking buffer, 1 h RT dark
detailedSteps.zh: **荧光二抗**: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647 等，封闭液 1:200–1:1000 稀释，室温避光 1 h

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **DAPI**: 1 µg/mL in PBS, 5 min RT. Wash 2× PBS
detailedSteps.zh: **DAPI 染核**: 1 µg/mL PBS 溶液，室温 5 min。PBS 洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: **Mount**: Add small drop of mounting medium on slide. Place coverslip cell-side down. Avoid bubbles. Seal edges with nail polish
detailedSteps.zh: **封片**: 在载玻片上滴少量封片剂。盖玻片细胞面朝下放置。避免气泡。指甲油封边

detailedSteps.en: Let cure 24 h at RT (or 4°C overnight). Image within 1 week for best signal
detailedSteps.zh: 室温固化 24 h（或 4°C 过夜）。1 周内成像信号最佳

protocols.name: ChIP Protocol (Chromatin IP)

components.name: 1. 交联: 1% 甲醛 10 min RT
3. 冷 PBS 洗 2×, 收细胞
8. 加抗体 + Protein A/G beads 4°C 过夜
11. 解交联: 65°C 过夜 + Proteinase K

instructions.zh: 超声条件需针对不同细胞系优化。阳性对照: H3 抗体；阴性对照: IgG。建议每次至少 1×10⁶ 细胞。结果用 % Input 或 Fold Enrichment 表示。
instructions.en: Optimize sonication conditions for each cell line. Positive control: H3 antibody; negative: IgG. Recommend ≥1×10⁶ cells. Express results as % Input or Fold Enrichment.

protocols.reference: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185; Collas (2010) Mol Biotechnol 45:87–100; Haring et al. (2007) Plant Methods 3:11

usage.en: Map protein-DNA interactions genome-wide. Identifies transcription factor binding sites and histone modifications. Combine with qPCR or sequencing (ChIP-seq).
usage.zh: 全基因组水平检测蛋白-DNA 相互作用。鉴定转录因子结合位点和组蛋白修饰。可结合 qPCR 或测序（ChIP-seq）。

briefSteps.en: Crosslink → lyse → sonicate → IP with antibody+beads → wash → elute → reverse crosslink → purify DNA → qPCR/seq
briefSteps.zh: 交联 → 裂解 → 超声 → 抗体+磁珠 IP → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → 解交联 → 纯化 DNA → qPCR/测序

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Crosslinking & Sonication**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 交联与超声**

detailedSteps.en: **Crosslink**: Add 37% formaldehyde directly to culture media to 1% final (270 µL per 10 mL media). Rock 10 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **交联**: 向培养基中直接加入 37% 甲醛至终浓度 1%（每 10 mL 培养基加 270 µL）。室温摇 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Quench**: Add 2.5 M glycine to 125 mM final. Rock 5 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **终止**: 加 2.5 M 甘氨酸至终浓度 125 mM。室温摇 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× cold PBS. Scrape cells in PBS + protease inhibitors. Pellet 800×g 5 min 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 冷 PBS 洗 2 次。PBS + 蛋白酶抑制剂中刮下细胞。4°C 800×g 离心 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Resuspend pellet in SDS Lysis Buffer (200 µL per 1×10⁶ cells). Incubate ice 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 用 SDS Lysis Buffer 重悬沉淀（每 1×10⁶ 细胞 200 µL）。冰上 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Sonication**: Shear chromatin to 200–500 bp. ⚠️ Must optimize! (e.g., Bioruptor: 30s on/30s off, 15–25 cycles)
detailedSteps.zh: **超声**: 将染色质剪切至 200–500 bp。⚠️ 必须优化条件！（如 Bioruptor: 30s 开/30s 关，15–25 个循环）

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Check shearing: take 10 µL aliquot, reverse crosslink (65°C + Proteinase K), run on 1.5% agarose gel
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 检查剪切效果：取 10 µL，解交联（65°C + Proteinase K），跑 1.5% 琼脂糖凝胶

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 14,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant (= sheared chromatin)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 14,000×g 离心 10 min。取上清（= 剪切后染色质）

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute**: Add 9 volumes ChIP Dilution Buffer (reduces SDS from 1% to 0.1%)
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释**: 加 9 倍体积 ChIP Dilution Buffer（将 SDS 从 1% 降至 0.1%）

detailedSteps.en: **Save Input**: Remove 1–10% as "Input" control → store at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: **留 Input**: 取 1–10% 作为 Input 对照 → -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1–2 — Immunoprecipitation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1–2 天 — 免疫沉淀**

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-clear** (optional): Add 20 µL protein A/G beads, rotate 1 h at 4°C. Remove beads
detailedSteps.zh: **预清除**（可选）：加 20 µL protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转 1 h。去除磁珠

detailedSteps.en: Add antibody (2–5 µg) + 30 µL protein A/G beads. Rotate overnight at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 加抗体（2–5 µg）+ 30 µL protein A/G 磁珠。4°C 旋转过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2–3 — Washes & Elution**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2–3 天 — 洗涤与洗脱**

detailedSteps.en: Wash sequentially (each 3–5 min, 4°C, rotation): Low-salt → High-salt → LiCl wash → 2× TE buffer
detailedSteps.zh: 依次洗涤（每次 3–5 min, 4°C 旋转）：低盐 → 高盐 → LiCl 洗 → 2× TE 缓冲液

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Add 250 µL elution buffer (1% SDS + 0.1 M NaHCO₃), vortex 15 min RT. Repeat. Pool eluates (500 µL total)
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 加 250 µL 洗脱液（1% SDS + 0.1 M NaHCO₃），室温涡旋 15 min。重复一次。合并洗脱液（共 500 µL）

detailedSteps.en: **Reverse crosslink**: Add NaCl to 200 mM final. Incubate 65°C overnight (or 65°C 4h). Also reverse-crosslink Input
detailedSteps.zh: **解交联**: 加 NaCl 至终浓度 200 mM。65°C 过夜（或 65°C 4h）。Input 同时解交联

detailedSteps.en: Add Proteinase K (20 µg/mL), 45°C, 1 h. Add RNase A, 37°C, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 加 Proteinase K（20 µg/mL），45°C 1 h。加 RNase A，37°C 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Purify DNA**: Phenol-chloroform extraction or column purification (MinElute). Elute in 30 µL TE
detailedSteps.zh: **纯化 DNA**: 酚-氯仿抽提或柱纯化（MinElute）。30 µL TE 洗脱

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: qPCR (% Input method) or library prep for ChIP-seq
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: qPCR（% Input 法）或建库做 ChIP-seq

protocols.name: Co-IP Protocol

components.name: 1. 裂解 (IP Lysis Buffer, 冰上 30 min)
5. 加目标抗体 (1–5 µg) 4°C 过夜
8. 加 2× Loading Buffer 煮沸洗脱
9. WB 检测 bait + prey 蛋白

instructions.zh: 阴性对照: 同种属 IgG。勿用 RIPA (SDS 会破坏互作)。裂解液中 NP-40 浓度根据互作强度调整 (0.1–1%)。建议每样 500 µg–2 mg 蛋白。
instructions.en: Negative control: matched isotype IgG. Do not use RIPA (SDS disrupts protein interactions). Adjust NP-40 concentration to interaction strength (0.1–1%). Recommend ≥500 µg total protein.

protocols.reference: Miernyk & Thelen (2008) Plant J 55:415–425; Kaboord & Bhatt (2008) Methods Mol Biol 424:349–364

usage.en: Detect protein-protein interactions in native conditions. Pull down a "bait" protein with its antibody and detect co-precipitated "prey" proteins by WB.
usage.zh: 在天然条件下检测蛋白-蛋白相互作用。用抗体沉淀"诱饵"蛋白，通过 WB 检测共沉淀的"猎物"蛋白。

briefSteps.en: Lyse (mild buffer) → quantify → pre-clear → add Ab overnight → beads → wash → elute → WB for bait+prey
briefSteps.zh: 温和裂解 → 定量 → 预清除 → 加抗体过夜 → 磁珠 → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → WB 检测 bait+prey

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Wash cells 1× cold PBS. Add IP Lysis Buffer (500 µL per 10-cm dish). ⚠️ Do NOT use RIPA — SDS disrupts interactions!
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 冷 PBS 洗 1 次。加 IP Lysis Buffer（10 cm 皿每皿 500 µL）。⚠️ 不要用 RIPA——SDS 会破坏蛋白互作！

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice 30 min with occasional vortexing. Centrifuge 14,000×g, 15 min, 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上裂解 30 min，偶尔涡旋。4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify**: BCA assay. Use 500 µg – 2 mg total protein per IP. Save 5–10% as Input
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: BCA 法。每次 IP 用 500 µg – 2 mg 总蛋白。留 5–10% 做 Input

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-clear**: Add 20 µL protein A/G beads, rotate 1 h at 4°C. Remove beads (reduces non-specific binding)
detailedSteps.zh: **预清除**: 加 20 µL protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转 1 h。去除磁珠（减少非特异结合）

detailedSteps.en: **IP**: Add 1–5 µg target antibody. In parallel, set up IgG control with same amount of normal IgG. Rotate overnight 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: **IP**: 加 1–5 µg 目标抗体。同时设 IgG 对照（同量正常 IgG）。4°C 旋转过夜

detailedSteps.en: Add 30–50 µL protein A/G beads. Rotate 2–4 h at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 加 30–50 µL protein A/G 磁珠。4°C 旋转 2–4 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: 4–6× with cold IP Lysis Buffer. Each wash: add 500 µL, rotate 5 min 4°C, pellet beads
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 冷 IP Lysis Buffer 洗 4–6 次。每次：加 500 µL，4°C 旋转 5 min，收集磁珠

detailedSteps.en: 💡 For weak interactions: reduce washes to 3× and use gentler buffer (0.1% NP-40)
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 弱相互作用：减少洗涤至 3 次，使用更温和的缓冲液（0.1% NP-40）

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Add 40 µL 2× Laemmli buffer to beads. Boil 95°C 5 min. Collect supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 向磁珠加 40 µL 2× Laemmli buffer。95°C 煮沸 5 min。收集上清

detailedSteps.en: **WB**: Load IP eluate, IgG control, and Input. Probe for both bait and prey proteins
detailedSteps.zh: **WB 检测**: 上样 IP 洗脱液、IgG 对照和 Input。分别检测 bait 和 prey 蛋白

protocols.name: RT-qPCR Protocol
protocols.nameZh: 实时荧光定量 PCR 流程

instructions.zh: 内参基因: GAPDH / ACTB / 18S rRNA。分析: 2^(-ΔΔCt) 法。技术重复 ≥3，生物学重复 ≥3。引物效率应在 90–110%。NTC (no template control) 必需。
instructions.en: Reference genes: GAPDH / ACTB / 18S rRNA. Analysis: 2^(−ΔΔCt) method. ≥3 technical replicates, ≥3 biological replicates. Primer efficiency should be 90–110%.

protocols.reference: Bustin et al. (2009) Clin Chem 55:611–622 (MIQE Guidelines); Livak & Schmittgen (2001) Methods 25:402–408

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 天实验（RNA 提取后）

usage.en: Quantify gene expression at mRNA level. Combines reverse transcription with real-time PCR. Gold standard for validating RNA-seq hits. Requires proper controls and MIQE compliance.
usage.zh: 在 mRNA 水平定量基因表达。结合逆转录和实时 PCR。验证 RNA-seq 结果的金标准。需要适当对照并符合 MIQE 规范。

briefSteps.en: Extract RNA → DNase → RT → dilute cDNA → qPCR (SYBR) → melt curve → analyze by 2^(-ΔΔCt)
briefSteps.zh: RNA 提取 → DNase → 反转录 → 稀释 cDNA → qPCR (SYBR) → 溶解曲线 → 2^(-ΔΔCt) 分析

detailedSteps.en: **RNA quality check**: Measure A260/280 (should be ~2.0). A260/230 >1.7. Optionally check on agarose gel (28S:18S ~2:1)
**DNase treatment** (recommended): Use TURBO DNase or on-column DNase. Heat-inactivate 75°C 5 min or use DNase removal reagent
detailedSteps.zh: **DNase 处理**（推荐）：用 TURBO DNase 或柱上 DNase。75°C 5 min 热灭活或用 DNase 去除试剂

detailedSteps.en: **Reverse transcription**: Use 500 ng–2 µg RNA per 20 µL reaction. Use oligo-dT + random hexamer mix for best coverage
detailedSteps.zh: **反转录**: 每 20 µL 反应体系用 500 ng–2 µg RNA。Oligo-dT + 随机六聚体混合引物效果最好

detailedSteps.en: RT program: 25°C 5 min → 42–50°C 30–60 min → 85°C 5 min (inactivation). Store cDNA at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: RT 程序：25°C 5 min → 42–50°C 30–60 min → 85°C 5 min（灭活）。cDNA -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute cDNA**: 1:5 to 1:20 with nuclease-free H₂O (typically 1:10). Include –RT control (no reverse transcriptase)
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释 cDNA**: 用无核酸酶水 1:5 至 1:20 稀释（通常 1:10）。设置 –RT 对照（不加逆转录酶）

detailedSteps.en: **qPCR setup (20 µL)**: 10 µL 2× SYBR Master Mix + 0.4 µL Fw primer (10 µM) + 0.4 µL Rv primer (10 µM) + 2 µL cDNA + 7.2 µL H₂O
detailedSteps.zh: **qPCR 体系 (20 µL)**: 10 µL 2× SYBR Master Mix + 0.4 µL Fw 引物 (10 µM) + 0.4 µL Rv 引物 (10 µM) + 2 µL cDNA + 7.2 µL H₂O

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Set up on ice. Include NTC (no template control) for every primer pair. Technical replicates ≥3
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 冰上操作。每对引物设 NTC（无模板对照）。技术重复 ≥3

detailedSteps.en: **Cycling**: 95°C 10 min (polymerase activation) → [95°C 15 s → 60°C 60 s] × 40 cycles → Melt curve: 60°C→95°C
**Melt curve analysis**: Single peak = specific product ✓. Multiple peaks = non-specific or primer dimers ✗
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解曲线分析**: 单峰 = 特异性产物 ✓。多峰 = 非特异或引物二聚体 ✗

detailedSteps.en: **Primer efficiency**: Make 5-point serial dilution of cDNA (1:4). Plot Ct vs log(dilution). Slope should be -3.2 to -3.5 (efficiency 90–110%)
detailedSteps.zh: **引物效率**: 做 5 点 cDNA 梯度稀释（1:4）。Ct vs log(稀释) 作图。斜率应为 -3.2 ~ -3.5（效率 90–110%）

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: ΔCt = Ct(target) – Ct(reference). ΔΔCt = ΔCt(treated) – ΔCt(control). Fold change = 2^(-ΔΔCt)
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: ΔCt = Ct(目标) – Ct(内参)。ΔΔCt = ΔCt(处理组) – ΔCt(对照组)。倍数变化 = 2^(-ΔΔCt)

detailedSteps.en: Bio reps ≥3. Stats: t-test on ΔCt values (NOT fold changes). Report as mean ± SEM
detailedSteps.zh: 生物学重复 ≥3。统计：对 ΔCt 值做 t 检验（不是倍数变化）。报告 mean ± SEM

note.zh: 参见 TRIzol 提取方案

protocols.name: Lipofection Transfection Protocol

components.name: 1. 转染前一天铺板 (60–80% 汇合度)
2. 管 A: 质粒 DNA in Opti-MEM
6. 6–8 h 后换新鲜完全培养基

instructions.zh: siRNA 转染: 每孔 25–50 pmol siRNA + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX。转染前换无血清培养基效果更好。DNA:Lipo 比例需优化 (1:2–1:4)。
instructions.en: siRNA: 25–50 pmol per well + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX. Switching to serum-free medium before transfection improves efficiency.

protocols.reference: Dalby et al. (2004) Methods 33:95–103; Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40; Thermo Fisher Lipofectamine Protocol

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1h 操作 + 24–72h 表达

usage.en: Deliver plasmid DNA or siRNA/miRNA into mammalian cells using cationic lipid reagents. Transient expression peaks 24–72h. For stable expression, add selection antibiotics.
usage.zh: 利用阳离子脂质试剂将质粒 DNA 或 siRNA/miRNA 导入哺乳动物细胞。瞬时表达高峰 24–72h。稳定表达需加筛选抗生素。

briefSteps.en: Plate cells → mix DNA/Opti-MEM (tube A) → mix Lipo/Opti-MEM (tube B) → combine A+B → add to cells → replace media 6h → harvest 24–72h
briefSteps.zh: 铺板 → DNA/Opti-MEM 混合(管A) → Lipo/Opti-MEM 混合(管B) → A+B 混合 → 加入细胞 → 6h 换液 → 24–72h 收样

detailedSteps.en: **Day before**: Plate cells to reach 60–80% confluency at transfection. Do NOT use antibiotics in plating media
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 铺板使转染时达到 60–80% 汇合度。铺板培养基不要加抗生素

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Cell density matters: too sparse = toxicity; too confluent = low efficiency. Optimize for each cell line
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 细胞密度很关键：太稀 = 毒性大；太密 = 效率低。每个细胞系需优化

detailedSteps.en: **Tube A — DNA mix**: For each well of 6-well plate: 2.5 µg DNA + 125 µL Opti-MEM. Mix gently
detailedSteps.zh: **管 A — DNA 混合**: 6 孔板每孔：2.5 µg DNA + 125 µL Opti-MEM。轻柔混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Tube B — Lipid mix**: 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000 (or 3.75 µL Lipo 3000 + 5 µL P3000) + 125 µL Opti-MEM
detailedSteps.zh: **管 B — 脂质混合**: 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000（或 3.75 µL Lipo 3000 + 5 µL P3000）+ 125 µL Opti-MEM

detailedSteps.en: Incubate each tube 5 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: 各管室温孵育 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Combine**: Add tube A into tube B (NOT the reverse). Mix gently. Incubate 15–20 min RT. Solution may become slightly cloudy
detailedSteps.zh: **混合**: 将管 A 加入管 B（不要反过来）。轻柔混匀。室温 15–20 min。溶液可能会轻微浑浊

detailedSteps.en: Add complex dropwise to cells. Rock plate gently to distribute
detailedSteps.zh: 将复合物逐滴加入细胞。轻摇培养板使其均匀分布

detailedSteps.en: **Replace media**: After 6–8 h, replace with fresh complete media (with serum, optional antibiotics)
detailedSteps.zh: **换液**: 6–8 h 后换新鲜完全培养基（含血清，可选抗生素）

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Check expression at 24 h (reporter), 48 h (protein), or 72 h (maximum protein accumulation)
detailedSteps.zh: **收样**: 24 h 检查表达（报告基因），48 h（蛋白），72 h（蛋白积累最大化）

detailedSteps.en: 💡 **siRNA transfection**: Use Lipofectamine RNAiMAX instead. 25–50 pmol siRNA per 6-well. Knockdown peaks at 48–72 h
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 **siRNA 转染**: 改用 Lipofectamine RNAiMAX。6 孔板每孔 25–50 pmol siRNA。敲低高峰在 48–72 h

note.zh: 无血清培养基，用于复合物形成

protocols.name: Flow Cytometry Surface Staining
protocols.nameZh: 流式细胞术表面染色流程

components.name: 3. Fc Block (人: Human TruStain; 鼠: anti-CD16/32)

instructions.zh: 胞内染色需先固定 (4% PFA 20 min) 再透化 (0.1% saponin)。每个抗体需单独滴度实验。compensation controls 必需。FMO controls 用于 gating。
instructions.en: For intracellular staining: fix with 4% PFA 20 min, then permeabilize with 0.1% saponin. Titrate each antibody individually. Compensation controls required.

protocols.reference: Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457–1973; Perfetto et al. (2004) Nat Rev Immunol 4:648–655

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 3 小时

usage.en: Analyze protein expression on individual cells by fluorescent antibody staining. Enables multi-parameter phenotyping, cell counting, and sorting (FACS).
usage.zh: 通过荧光抗体染色分析单个细胞的蛋白表达。支持多参数表型分析、细胞计数和分选（FACS）。

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Fc block → surface Ab stain 4°C 30min → wash → (fix → perm → intracellular stain) → viability dye → acquire ≥10K events
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞 → Fc 封闭 → 表面抗体 4°C 30min → 洗 → (固定 → 透化 → 胞内染色) → 活死染料 → 采集 ≥1 万事件

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Collect cells (trypsinize adherent cells gently, or collect suspension). Count. Use ≥1×10⁵ cells per tube
detailedSteps.zh: **收集**: 收集细胞（贴壁细胞轻柔消化，悬浮细胞直接收集）。计数。每管 ≥1×10⁵ 细胞

detailedSteps.en: Wash 1× PBS (300×g, 5 min). Resuspend in 100 µL FACS buffer
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 1 次（300×g，5 min）。重悬于 100 µL FACS buffer

detailedSteps.en: **Fc Block**: Add Fc receptor blocking reagent. Incubate 4°C 10 min. Do NOT wash
detailedSteps.zh: **Fc 封闭**: 加 Fc 受体封闭试剂。4°C 10 min。不洗

detailedSteps.en: **Surface staining**: Add fluorescent antibodies at titrated amounts. Incubate 4°C 20–30 min in the dark
detailedSteps.zh: **表面染色**: 按滴定量加入荧光抗体。4°C 避光孵育 20–30 min

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Antibody titration is ESSENTIAL: test 2-fold dilutions from manufacturer's recommendation to find the amount that gives best separation
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 抗体滴定是必须的：从厂商推荐量开始做 2 倍梯度稀释，找到分离度最佳的用量

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with 1 mL FACS buffer (300×g, 5 min)
detailedSteps.zh: 1 mL FACS buffer 洗 2 次（300×g, 5 min）

detailedSteps.en: **For surface staining only**: Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer + viability dye. Go to acquisition
detailedSteps.zh: **仅表面染色**: 重悬于 200–500 µL FACS buffer + 活死染料。直接上机

detailedSteps.en: **For intracellular staining** (optional):
detailedSteps.zh: **胞内染色**（可选）:

detailedSteps.en: Fix: 4% PFA 20 min RT. Wash 2× PBS
detailedSteps.zh: 固定：4% PFA 室温 20 min。PBS 洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: Permeabilize: 0.1% saponin or commercial Perm buffer, 15 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: 透化：0.1% 皂苷或商品化 Perm buffer，室温 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Stain intracellular targets in Perm buffer. 30 min RT dark. Wash 2×
detailedSteps.zh: 在 Perm buffer 中染胞内靶标。室温避光 30 min。洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: **Acquisition**: Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer. Acquire on flow cytometer
detailedSteps.zh: **上机**: 重悬于 200–500 µL FACS buffer。上流式细胞仪

detailedSteps.en: Acquire ≥10,000 events in live cell gate. For rare populations, acquire ≥100,000
detailedSteps.zh: 在活细胞门中采集 ≥10,000 个事件。稀有细胞群需采集 ≥100,000

detailedSteps.en: **Controls needed**: Unstained, single-stain (for compensation), FMO (for gating), isotype (optional)
detailedSteps.zh: **所需对照**: 未染色、单染（补偿用）、FMO（门控用）、同型对照（可选）

note.zh: Human TruStain FcX / 小鼠 anti-CD16/32
每个抗体需先单独做滴度实验！
DAPI、PI 或可固定 Live/Dead 染料

protocols.name: MOPS SDS Running Buffer (NuPAGE)

instructions.zh: 20× 浓缩液可储存，使用前稀释至 1×。适用于 NuPAGE Bis-Tris 凝胶，分离中-大分子量蛋白 (>30 kDa) 效果优于 MES。不需调 pH。
instructions.en: Can be stored as 20× concentrate. Dilute to 1× before use. Optimized for NuPAGE Bis-Tris gels; better resolution for mid-to-high MW proteins (>30 kDa) than MES buffer. Do not adjust pH.

protocols.reference: Invitrogen NuPAGE Technical Guide (Thermo Fisher MAN0003690); Schägger (2006) Nat Protoc 1:16–22

protocols.name: Colony PCR Protocol

components.name: 1. 挑取单克隆至 PCR 管 (牙签/枪头)

instructions.zh: 初始变性 5 min 用于裂解菌体释放模板。引物可用 M13 通用引物 (pUC 系列) 或基因特异引物。阳性克隆应送测序验证。同时划线保存菌落至新 LB 平板。
instructions.en: Initial 5 min denaturation at 95°C lyses bacteria to release template DNA. Use M13 universal primers (for pUC vectors) or gene-specific primers. Positive clones should be sequence-verified. Streak colonies onto a master plate in parallel.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.; Bergkessel & Guthrie (2013) Methods Enzymol 529:141–149

usage.en: Screen bacterial colonies for correct insert after transformation. Faster than miniprep + restriction digest. Screen 8–16 colonies per construct.
usage.zh: 转化后筛选含正确插入片段的菌落。比提质粒 + 酶切更快。每个构建体筛选 8–16 个菌落。

briefSteps.en: Set up PCR mix (25 µL): master mix + primers + water → pick colony with tip → dip in PCR tube → streak on replica plate → PCR: 95°C 10 min → 30 cycles → agarose gel → sequence positives
briefSteps.zh: 配 PCR 体系 (25 µL): master mix + 引物 + 水 → 枪头挑菌落 → 蘸入 PCR 管 → 划线到备份板 → PCR: 95°C 10 min → 30 个循环 → 琼脂糖凝胶 → 阳性送测序

detailedSteps.en: Prepare PCR master mix in a 1.5 mL tube: 12.5 µL 2× Taq mix, 1 µL each primer (10 µM), 10.5 µL water per reaction. Make N+1 reactions
detailedSteps.zh: 在 1.5 mL 管中配 PCR 体系：12.5 µL 2× Taq mix，各 1 µL 引物（10 µM），10.5 µL 水/反应。配 N+1 个反应

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 25 µL into each PCR tube. Label tubes to match colony numbers
detailedSteps.zh: 每管分装 25 µL，标记与菌落编号对应

detailedSteps.en: Using a sterile pipette tip or toothpick, touch a single colony lightly
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌枪头或牙签轻触单个菌落

detailedSteps.en: Dip the tip into the PCR tube and swirl briefly to release cells
detailedSteps.zh: 将枪头在 PCR 管中轻轻搅动释放细菌

detailedSteps.en: (Recommended) Streak the same tip onto a fresh replica plate. Label to match
detailedSteps.zh: （推荐）用同一枪头在备份平板上划线，标记编号

detailedSteps.en: Incubate replica plate at 37°C while PCR runs
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 运行时将备份板 37°C 培养

detailedSteps.en: Include negative control (no colony) and positive control (known template) if available
detailedSteps.zh: 设阴性对照（无菌落）和阳性对照（已知模板，如有）

detailedSteps.en: Run PCR: 95°C 10 min (lyses cells) → (95°C 30s, 55°C 30s, 72°C 1 min/kb) × 30 → 72°C 5 min → hold 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 程序: 95°C 10 min (裂解细菌) → (95°C 30s, 55°C 30s, 72°C 1 min/kb) × 30 → 72°C 5 min → 4°C 保持

detailedSteps.en: Add 5 µL of 6× loading dye to each 25 µL reaction
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加 5 µL 6× loading dye

detailedSteps.en: Run on 1% agarose gel alongside DNA ladder. Image: positive clones show band at expected insert size
detailedSteps.zh: 1% 琼脂糖凝胶电泳，加 DNA ladder。成像：阳性克隆在预期插入片段大小处有条带

detailedSteps.en: Inoculate 2–3 positive clones from replica plate into LB + antibiotic overnight, miniprep, and sequence-verify
detailedSteps.zh: 从备份板挑 2–3 个阳性克隆，接种到 LB + 抗生素过夜培养，提质粒，送测序验证

note.zh: M13 通用引物或基因特异引物
M13 通用引物或基因特异引物

protocols.name: Bacterial Glycerol Stock

instructions.zh: 轻柔混匀 (不要涡旋)。标记菌株名、质粒、抗性、日期。速冻于液氮或干冰，-80°C 长期保存。复苏时直接划线至含抗生素 LB 平板，切勿反复冻融。终甘油浓度 15–25% 均可。
instructions.en: Mix gently by inversion (do not vortex). Label tube with strain name, plasmid, resistance marker, and date. Snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen or dry ice, store at −80°C. To recover, streak directly onto selective plate from frozen stock. Never freeze-thaw. Final glycerol concentration of 15–25% is acceptable.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

protocols.name: 6× DNA Loading Dye

instructions.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存，4°C 可存数月。使用时 1:5 混合 (1 µL dye + 5 µL 样品)。Bromophenol Blue 在 1% 琼脂糖中迁移率 ~300 bp，Xylene Cyanol ~4 kb。可选加 EDTA (终浓度 10 mM) 螯合 DNase。
instructions.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C; stable at 4°C for months. Mix 1:5 with sample (1 µL dye + 5 µL sample). Bromophenol blue co-migrates with ~300 bp in 1% agarose; xylene cyanol co-migrates with ~4 kb. Optionally add EDTA (10 mM final) to chelate DNases.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

protocols.name: CaCl₂ Competent Cell Preparation
protocols.nameZh: CaCl₂ 化学感受态细胞制备

components.name: 1. 过夜培养 DH5α/BL21 → 1:100 接种至 50 mL LB
5. 弃上清，冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ 重悬
8. 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% 甘油 重悬
9. 分装 100 µL/管，液氮速冻，-80°C 保存

instructions.zh: 全程冰上操作！效率通常 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg。过夜 4°C 孵育可提高效率。如需更高效率 (>10⁸)，使用 Inoue 法 (MnCl₂/CaCl₂)。
instructions.en: Keep everything on ice throughout! Typical efficiency: 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg. Overnight incubation at 4°C can improve efficiency. For higher efficiency (>10⁸), use the Inoue method (MnCl₂/CaCl₂).

protocols.reference: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 4h + 过夜培养

usage.en: Prepare chemically competent E. coli cells for heat-shock transformation. Simple and cheap, yields 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg. Sufficient for routine cloning.
usage.zh: 制备化学感受态大肠杆菌用于热激转化。简单便宜，效率 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg。足够常规克隆使用。

briefSteps.en: Grow to OD 0.3–0.5 → ice 15 min → pellet → resuspend in cold CaCl₂ → ice 30 min → pellet → resuspend in CaCl₂ + glycerol → aliquot → snap-freeze
briefSteps.zh: 培养至 OD 0.3–0.5 → 冰浴 15 min → 离心 → 冷 CaCl₂ 重悬 → 冰浴 30 min → 离心 → CaCl₂ + 甘油重悬 → 分装 → 速冻

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0**: Inoculate single colony into 5 mL LB. Grow O/N at 37°C with shaking
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 挑单克隆接种 5 mL LB。37°C 振荡过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1**: Dilute O/N culture 1:100 into 50 mL fresh LB in 250 mL flask
detailedSteps.zh: **当天**: 过夜菌液 1:100 接种至 250 mL 锥形瓶中 50 mL 新鲜 LB

detailedSteps.en: Grow at 37°C with vigorous shaking until OD₆₀₀ = 0.3–0.5 (~2–3 h). ⚠️ Do NOT overgrow!
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 剧烈振荡至 OD₆₀₀ = 0.3–0.5（约 2–3 h）。⚠️ 不要过度生长！

detailedSteps.en: Transfer to pre-chilled 50 mL tube. Ice 15 min
detailedSteps.zh: 转移至预冷的 50 mL 管。冰浴 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 3000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Decant supernatant completely
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 3000×g 离心 10 min。完全倒掉上清

detailedSteps.en: Gently resuspend pellet in 25 mL ice-cold 100 mM CaCl₂ (pipet gently — do NOT vortex!)
detailedSteps.zh: 用 25 mL 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ 轻柔重悬沉淀（轻柔吹打——不要涡旋！）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴 30 min

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 3000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Decant carefully
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 3000×g 离心 10 min。小心倒掉上清

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend in 2.5 mL ice-cold 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% glycerol
detailedSteps.zh: 用 2.5 mL 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% 甘油 轻柔重悬

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 100 µL per pre-chilled 1.5 mL tube. Snap-freeze in liquid N₂. Store -80°C
detailedSteps.zh: 分装 100 µL/预冷管。液氮速冻。-80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Test efficiency**: Transform 1 ng pUC19, plate on LB + Amp. Count colonies next day
detailedSteps.zh: **效率测试**: 转化 1 ng pUC19，涂 LB + Amp 平板。次日计数菌落

protocols.name: 2×YT Medium

instructions.zh: ddH₂O 定容至 1000 mL，调 pH 至 7.0 (NaOH)。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min。比 LB 营养更丰富，适用于噬菌体展示、高密度蛋白表达等。冷却后加抗生素。
instructions.en: Dissolve in ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH, bring to volume. Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min. Richer than LB (2× yeast extract and tryptone), ideal for phage display and high-density protein expression. Add antibiotics after cooling.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

protocols.name: HEPES Buffer (1 M stock)

instructions.zh: 用 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.2–7.6。0.22 µm 过滤除菌。4°C 保存。细胞培养终浓度 10–25 mM。HEPES 在 CO₂ 培养箱外能维持 pH 稳定，适合长时间操作。避光保存。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 7.2–7.6 with NaOH. Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Store at 4°C protected from light. Use at 10–25 mM final concentration in culture medium. HEPES maintains pH stability outside the CO₂ incubator, ideal for extended bench work and live imaging.

protocols.reference: Good et al. (1966) Biochemistry 5:467–477; Sigma-Aldrich HEPES Buffer Protocol

protocols.name: 20× SSC Buffer

instructions.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.0。高压灭菌后室温保存。杂交 (Southern/Northern blot) 时使用 2×–6× SSC；严格洗膜用 0.1×–0.5× SSC。ISH (原位杂交) 也需要。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with HCl. Autoclave and store at room temperature. For Southern/Northern blot hybridization use 2×–6× SSC; for stringent washes use 0.1×–0.5× SSC. Also required for in situ hybridization (ISH).

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8765; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

protocols.name: Citrate Buffer (Antigen Retrieval)

instructions.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 6.0。微波法: 将切片浸入缓冲液，微波加热至沸腾后中低火维持 10–20 min，自然冷却至室温。也可用压力锅或水浴 (95–100°C)。适用于甲醛固定石蜡包埋 (FFPE) 组织。
instructions.en: Adjust pH to 6.0 with HCl. Microwave method: submerge slides in buffer, bring to boil then maintain at medium power for 10–20 min. Allow to cool to RT. Can also use pressure cooker or water bath (95–100°C). For FFPE tissue sections.

protocols.reference: Shi et al. (1991) J Histochem Cytochem 39:741–748

protocols.name: Crystal Violet Staining Solution

instructions.zh: 固定并染色贴壁细胞: PBS 洗 → 加染色液覆盖 → 室温 20 min → ddH₂O 反复冲洗 → 晾干。定量: 加 10% 冰醋酸溶解结晶紫，OD₅₉₅ 测吸光度。适用于克隆形成实验 (colony formation assay) 和生物膜检测。
instructions.en: Fix and stain adherent cells: wash with PBS, apply staining solution for 20 min at RT, rinse thoroughly with ddH₂O, air-dry. To quantify: dissolve stain in 10% acetic acid, read absorbance at OD₅₉₅. Used for colony formation assays and biofilm detection.

protocols.reference: Feoktistova et al. (2016) Cold Spring Harb Protoc 2016(4):pdb.prot087379

protocols.name: Trypan Blue Cell Counting

components.name: 4. 轻柔混匀，室温 1–2 min (勿超 3 min)
5. 加入血球计数板 / 自动计数仪
6. 计数: 活细胞 (透明) vs 死细胞 (蓝色)

instructions.zh: 细胞密度 = 平均每大格细胞数 × 稀释倍数 × 10⁴ cells/mL。活率 = 活细胞/(活+死) × 100%。染色时间 >3 min 会导致假阳性 (活细胞也着色)。如浓度过高，进一步稀释后重新计数。
instructions.en: Cell density = average cells per large square × dilution factor × 10⁴ cells/mL. Viability = live / (live + dead) × 100%. Staining beyond 3 min causes false positives (live cells begin to take up dye). Dilute further if concentration is too high.

protocols.reference: Strober (2015) Curr Protoc Immunol 111:A.3B.1–A.3B.3

usage.en: Count cells and determine viability before seeding, passaging, or experiments. Dead cells take up trypan blue (blue), live cells exclude it (clear).
usage.zh: 在接种、传代或实验前计数细胞并判断活力。死细胞摄取台盼蓝（蓝色），活细胞排斥（透明）。

briefSteps.en: Prepare single-cell suspension → mix 10 µL cells + 10 µL trypan blue → load 10 µL onto hemocytometer → count 4 corner squares (live = clear, dead = blue) → calculate: cells/mL = (count ÷ 4) × 2 × 10⁴
briefSteps.zh: 制备单细胞悬液 → 10 µL 细胞 + 10 µL 台盼蓝 → 取 10 µL 加入计数板 → 数 4 个角大格（活=透明, 死=蓝色）→ 计算: cells/mL = (计数 ÷ 4) × 2 × 10⁴

detailedSteps.en: Trypsinize adherent cells or resuspend suspension cells. Ensure single-cell suspension (no clumps)
detailedSteps.zh: 消化贴壁细胞或重悬悬浮细胞，确保单细胞悬液（无团块）

detailedSteps.en: Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube. Take a 20 µL aliquot for counting
detailedSteps.zh: 转移到 15 mL 管，取 20 µL 用于计数

detailedSteps.en: Mix 10 µL of cell suspension with 10 µL of 0.4% trypan blue in a microcentrifuge tube
detailedSteps.zh: 在微量离心管中将 10 µL 细胞悬液与 10 µL 0.4% 台盼蓝混匀

detailedSteps.en: Incubate for 1–2 min at RT. Do NOT exceed 5 min (trypan blue becomes toxic to live cells)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温孵育 1–2 分钟。不超过 5 分钟（台盼蓝对活细胞有毒性）

detailedSteps.en: Clean hemocytometer and coverslip with 70% ethanol. Dry completely
detailedSteps.zh: 用 70% 乙醇清洁血球计数板和盖玻片，完全干燥

detailedSteps.en: Place coverslip on hemocytometer. It should adhere by surface tension (Newton rings visible)
detailedSteps.zh: 放置盖玻片，应通过表面张力贴合（可见牛顿环）

detailedSteps.en: Load 10 µL of the trypan blue mixture into one chamber. Let it fill by capillary action
detailedSteps.zh: 取 10 µL 台盼蓝混合物加入一侧计数室，利用毛细作用填充

detailedSteps.en: Place on microscope at 10× magnification
detailedSteps.zh: 放在显微镜下 10× 观察

detailedSteps.en: Count all four corner squares (each 1 mm × 1 mm). Count live cells (clear/refractile) and dead cells (blue) separately
detailedSteps.zh: 计数四个角大格（每个 1 mm × 1 mm）。分别计数活细胞（透明/折光）和死细胞（蓝色）

detailedSteps.en: Follow convention: count cells touching top and left borders, skip bottom and right
detailedSteps.zh: 规则：计数触碰上线和左线的细胞，不计下线和右线的

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate concentration**: Cells/mL = (total live count ÷ 4 squares) × dilution factor (2) × 10⁴
detailedSteps.zh: **计算浓度**: 细胞/mL = (4 格活细胞总数 ÷ 4) × 稀释倍数 (2) × 10⁴

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate viability**: % viable = (live count ÷ total count) × 100. Should be >90% for healthy cultures
detailedSteps.zh: **计算活率**: 活率% = (活细胞数 ÷ 总细胞数) × 100。健康培养 >90%

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate seeding volume**: Volume (mL) = desired cell count ÷ concentration (cells/mL)
detailedSteps.zh: **计算接种体积**: 体积 (mL) = 所需细胞数 ÷ 浓度 (cells/mL)

protocols.name: 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA Solution

instructions.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。分装后 -20°C 保存，工作液 4°C (2 周内用完)。使用前预热至 37°C。消化时间需根据细胞类型优化 (1–5 min)。加含血清培养基终止消化。EDTA 螯合 Ca²⁺ 破坏细胞间连接辅助消化。
instructions.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Aliquot and store at −20°C; working aliquots at 4°C for up to 2 weeks. Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Optimize digestion time for each cell type (1–5 min). Neutralize with serum-containing medium. EDTA chelates Ca²⁺ to disrupt cell-cell junctions.

protocols.reference: Freshney (2010) Culture of Animal Cells, 6th ed., Wiley

protocols.name: DEPC-Treated Water

instructions.zh: 加 0.1% DEPC 到水中，剧烈摇匀，37°C 孵育 12h（或室温 2h），然后高压灭菌 15 min 分解 DEPC。用于 RNA 实验。不要加 DEPC 到 Tris 缓冲液（与氨基反应）。
instructions.en: Add 0.1% DEPC to water, shake vigorously, incubate 12h at 37°C (or 2h at RT), then autoclave 15 min to decompose DEPC. Use for RNA work. Do NOT add DEPC to Tris buffers (reacts with amine groups). Modern alternative: commercial nuclease-free water.

protocols.reference: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8135; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

protocols.name: Protein Loading Buffer (Non-Reducing)
protocols.nameZh: 蛋白上样缓冲液 (非还原型)

instructions.zh: 不含 β-巯基乙醇或 DTT。用于非还原 SDS-PAGE：保留二硫键，适合检测多聚体、IgG 重/轻链不分离、或配体-受体复合物。与样品 1:1 混合后 70°C 加热 10 min (不要煮沸，避免聚集)。
instructions.en: No β-mercaptoethanol or DTT. Use for non-reducing SDS-PAGE: preserves disulfide bonds, suitable for detecting multimers, intact IgG heavy/light chains, or ligand-receptor complexes. Mix 1:1 with sample and heat at 70°C for 10 min (do not boil to avoid aggregation).

protocols.reference: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

protocols.name: 0.1% Triton X-100 Permeabilization Buffer

instructions.zh: 用于固定后的细胞透化 (PFA 固定后)。室温处理 10–15 min。Triton 浓度 0.1–0.5% 可选，浓度越高透化越强但形态保存越差。对于核抗原，0.5% 效果更好。使用后 PBS 洗 3 次再做免疫染色。
instructions.en: Apply to PFA-fixed cells only. Incubate at RT for 10–15 min. Triton concentration can range 0.1–0.5%; higher concentrations increase permeabilization but reduce morphology preservation. Use 0.5% for nuclear antigens. Wash 3× with PBS before immunostaining.

protocols.reference: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.7

protocols.name: DAPI Staining Solution

instructions.zh: DAPI stock: 5 mg 溶于 1 mL ddH₂O，分装后 -20°C 避光保存。工作液 (1 µg/mL) 现配现用。固定透化后的细胞: 室温避光孵育 5–10 min，PBS 洗 2 次。Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (蓝色荧光)。活细胞不透膜，用于死细胞排除 (流式 0.1–0.5 µg/mL)。封片用含 DAPI 的封片剂更方便。
instructions.en: DAPI stock: dissolve 5 mg in 1 mL ddH₂O, aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light. Working solution (1 µg/mL) should be prepared fresh. For fixed/permeabilized cells: incubate 5–10 min at RT in the dark, wash 2× with PBS. Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (blue fluorescence). Membrane-impermeant in live cells — used for dead cell exclusion in flow cytometry (0.1–0.5 µg/mL). Mounting media with DAPI is more convenient for microscopy.

protocols.reference: Kapuscinski (1995) Biotech Histochem 70:220–233

protocols.name: Calcium Phosphate Transfection

components.name: 1. 转染前一天铺板至 50–70% 汇合度
- 2× HBS: 280 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 1.5 mM Na₂HPO₄, pH 7.05
4. 逐滴将管 A 加入管 B，边滴边吹泡 (用巴氏管)
5. 室温静置 20 min (形成 DNA-Ca₃(PO₄)₂ 沉淀)
6. 逐滴加入培养皿，轻柔晃匀
9. 48–72 h 后收获 (蛋白表达 / 病毒上清)

instructions.zh: 2× HBS 的 pH 必须精确到 7.05 ± 0.02，偏差会严重影响效率！可选 glycerol shock: 转染后 8 h 用 15% 甘油/PBS 处理 2 min，PBS 洗 2 次，换新培养基。HEK293/293T 效率可达 80–90%。慢病毒包装首选此法 (成本低)。
instructions.en: 2× HBS pH must be precisely 7.05 ± 0.02; deviations severely reduce efficiency. Optional glycerol shock: treat with 15% glycerol/PBS for 2 min at 8 h post-transfection, wash 2× PBS, replace medium. HEK293/293T efficiency can reach 80–90%. Preferred method for lentivirus packaging (low cost).

protocols.reference: Kingston et al. (2003) Curr Protoc Mol Biol 9.1.1–9.1.11; Graham & van der Eb (1973) Virology 52:456–467

usage.en: Classic, cost-effective transfection method. Transfect HEK293T, HeLa, and other easily transfectable cell lines. 80–90% efficiency for HEK293T. Widely used for lentivirus packaging.
usage.zh: 经典、低成本的转染方法。适用于 HEK293T、HeLa 等易转染细胞系。HEK293T 效率可达 80–90%。广泛用于慢病毒包装。

briefSteps.en: Plate cells → mix DNA + CaCl₂ → drop into 2× HBS while bubbling → incubate 20 min → add to cells → O/N → change media → harvest 48–72h
briefSteps.zh: 铺板 → DNA + CaCl₂ 混合 → 逐滴加入 2× HBS 同时吹泡 → 20 min → 加至细胞 → 过夜 → 换液 → 48–72h 收获

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0**: Plate cells to 50–70% confluency by next morning (e.g., 4×10⁶ HEK293T per 10 cm dish)
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 铺板至次日 50–70% 汇合度（如 HEK293T 4×10⁶/10 cm 皿）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Transfection**:
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 转染**:

detailedSteps.en: Change to fresh medium 1–2 h before transfection. Include 25 µM chloroquine (optional, boosts efficiency 2–3×)
detailedSteps.zh: 转染前 1–2 h 换新鲜培养基。可选加 25 µM 氯喹（提高效率 2–3 倍）

detailedSteps.en: Tube A: Mix 20 µg DNA + 50 µL 2.5M CaCl₂ + ddH₂O to 500 µL total
detailedSteps.zh: 管 A: 20 µg DNA + 50 µL 2.5M CaCl₂ + ddH₂O 补至 500 µL

detailedSteps.en: Tube B: Add 500 µL 2× HBS. Insert Pasteur pipet connected to pipet-aid, start bubbling air
detailedSteps.zh: 管 B: 加 500 µL 2× HBS。插入连接移液器的巴斯德吸管，开始吹泡

detailedSteps.en: Add Tube A dropwise to Tube B while continuously bubbling. This ensures fine precipitate formation
detailedSteps.zh: 逐滴将管 A 加入管 B，同时持续吹泡。这确保形成细小沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at RT 15–20 min. Solution should appear slightly turbid (fine precipitate)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 15–20 min。溶液应略显浑浊（细小沉淀）

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ If solution is clear → precipitate did not form (check 2× HBS pH!). If chunky/flocculent → precipitate too large (won't work)
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 如果溶液澄清 → 未形成沉淀（检查 2× HBS pH！）。如果絮状/块状 → 沉淀太大（不会起效）

detailedSteps.en: Add dropwise to dish while swirling gently. Return to 37°C incubator
detailedSteps.zh: 边轻柔晃动培养皿边逐滴加入。放回 37°C 培养箱

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2**: Replace medium after 12–16 h. Fine granular precipitate on cells is normal and good
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天**: 12–16 h 后换液。细胞上的细颗粒状沉淀是正常的好现象

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3**: Harvest protein expression at 48 h or collect virus supernatant at 48–72 h
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天**: 48 h 收获蛋白表达或 48–72 h 收集病毒上清

protocols.name: Bacterial Transformation (Heat Shock)

components.name: 1. Thaw competent cells on ice (5 min)
3. Mix gently by flicking. Ice 30 min
8. Plate on selective LB agar + antibiotic

instructions.zh: 连接产物用 5 µL (= 整个连接体系的 1/4–1/2)。DNA 体积不超过感受态体积的 10%。42°C 热激时间严格控制在 30–60 s。SOC 比 LB 恢复效率高 2–5 倍。Amp 抗性: 1 h 恢复即可；Kan 抗性: 建议恢复 1.5 h。如转化效率低，检查: (1) 感受态效率 (2) DNA 纯度 (3) 热激时间。
instructions.en: Use 5 µL of ligation product (1/4 to 1/2 of the reaction). DNA volume should not exceed 10% of competent cell volume. Heat shock at 42°C for exactly 30–60 s. SOC medium gives 2–5× better recovery than LB. For Amp resistance: 1 h recovery is sufficient; for Kan resistance: 1.5 h recommended. If transformation efficiency is low, check: (1) competent cell quality, (2) DNA purity, (3) heat shock timing.

protocols.reference: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 小时 + 过夜培养

usage.en: Standard method for introducing plasmid DNA into chemically competent E. coli. Used for cloning, protein expression, and library construction. Quick (2 h from thaw to plating).
usage.zh: 将质粒 DNA 导入化学感受态大肠杆菌的标准方法。用于克隆、蛋白表达和文库构建。快速（从解冻到涂板 2 h）。

briefSteps.en: Thaw cells on ice → add DNA → ice 30 min → 42°C 45 s → ice 2 min → add SOC → 37°C 1 h → plate on selective agar → O/N 37°C
briefSteps.zh: 冰上解冻感受态 → 加 DNA → 冰浴 30 min → 42°C 45 s → 冰浴 2 min → 加 SOC → 37°C 1 h → 涂选择性平板 → 37°C 过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**: Pre-warm selective LB agar plates at 37°C (at least 30 min to dry surface moisture)
detailedSteps.zh: **准备**: 选择性 LB 琼脂平板 37°C 预热（至少 30 min 烘干表面水分）

detailedSteps.en: Thaw one aliquot of competent cells on ice for 5 min. Do NOT warm with hands
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上解冻一管感受态细胞 5 min。不要用手温暖

detailedSteps.en: **Add DNA**: Gently pipette 1–5 µL DNA (1–50 ng) directly into cells. Flick tube gently 4–5×. Do NOT vortex or pipet up/down
detailedSteps.zh: **加 DNA**: 轻柔移取 1–5 µL DNA (1–50 ng) 直接加入细胞。轻弹管壁 4–5 次。不要涡旋或反复吹打

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ DNA volume must be ≤10% of cell volume (e.g., ≤5 µL into 50 µL cells). Excess volume reduces efficiency dramatically
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ DNA 体积必须 ≤ 感受态体积的 10%（如 50 µL 细胞中加 ≤5 µL）。过量会严重降低效率

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice for 30 min. Do not shake or move the tube
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴 30 min。不要摇动或移动管子

detailedSteps.en: **Heat shock**: Transfer tube to 42°C water bath for exactly 45 seconds. Start timer before placing tube
detailedSteps.zh: **热激**: 将管子转移至 42°C 水浴，精确 45 秒。放入前开始计时

detailedSteps.en: Immediately return to ice for 2 min. This step is critical for survival
detailedSteps.zh: 立即放回冰上 2 min。此步对细胞存活至关重要

detailedSteps.en: **Recovery**: Add 950 µL room-temperature SOC medium (or LB). SOC gives 2–5× better efficiency
detailedSteps.zh: **恢复**: 加入 950 µL 室温 SOC 培养基（或 LB）。SOC 效率高 2–5 倍

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 225 rpm for 1 hour (Amp) or 1.5 hours (Kan/Cm)
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 225 rpm 振荡 1 小时 (Amp) 或 1.5 小时 (Kan/Cm)

detailedSteps.en: **Plating**: For routine cloning: plate 100 µL directly + spin down remainder and plate. For ligation: plate everything
detailedSteps.zh: **涂板**: 常规克隆: 直接涂 100 µL + 剩余离心后涂板。连接产物: 全部涂板

detailedSteps.en: Spread evenly with sterile glass beads or spreader. Allow plates to dry 5 min (lid slightly open)
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌玻璃珠或涂布棒均匀涂开。开盖干燥 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Invert plates. Incubate at 37°C for 12–16 hours. Do not exceed 16 h (satellite colonies form)
detailedSteps.zh: 倒置平板。37°C 培养 12–16 小时。不要超过 16 h（会出现卫星菌落）

detailedSteps.en: **Controls**: Always include: (1) no-DNA negative control, (2) uncut vector positive control, (3) cut-only vector control (background)
detailedSteps.zh: **对照**: 始终设置: (1) 无 DNA 阴性对照, (2) 未切割载体阳性对照, (3) 仅切割载体对照（背景）

protocols.name: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis

components.name: 2. 微波加热至完全溶解 (注意防沸)
4. 倒入胶板，插梳，室温凝固 20–30 min
5. 样品与 6× Loading Dye 混合 (5:1)

instructions.zh: TAE 适合大片段和胶回收 (低离子强度，跑得慢易切胶)；TBE 分辨率更高适合小片段 (<1 kb)。EtBr 致癌，推荐用 GelRed/SYBR Safe 等替代品。电泳缓冲液和制胶缓冲液须一致。避免气泡。RNA 胶需用甲醛变性凝胶。
instructions.en: TAE is better for large fragments and gel extraction (low ionic strength, easier to cut bands); TBE provides higher resolution for small fragments (<1 kb). EtBr is carcinogenic — use GelRed/SYBR Safe alternatives. Running buffer and gel buffer must match. Avoid air bubbles. RNA gels require formaldehyde denaturing agarose.

protocols.reference: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.; Lee et al. (2012) J Vis Exp 62:e3923

usage.en: Separate DNA fragments by size (100 bp – 25 kb). Use 0.8% for large fragments, 2% for small. Standard for PCR product analysis, restriction digests, quality checks, and gel extraction.
usage.zh: 按大小分离 DNA 片段（100 bp – 25 kb）。大片段用 0.8%，小片段用 2%。用于 PCR 产物分析、酶切鉴定、质量检查和胶回收。

briefSteps.en: Dissolve agarose in buffer → microwave → cool to 55°C → add stain → pour gel → insert comb → solidify 20–30 min → load samples + ladder → run 80–120V 30–60 min → image under UV/blue light
briefSteps.zh: 溶解琼脂糖 → 微波 → 冷至 55°C → 加染料 → 倒胶 → 插梳 → 凝固 20–30 min → 上样 + Ladder → 80–120V 电泳 30–60 min → UV/蓝光成像

detailedSteps.en: **Choose agarose %**: 0.8% for >1 kb, 1% for 0.5–7 kb, 1.5% for 0.2–3 kb, 2% for <500 bp
Weigh agarose powder (e.g. 1 g per 100 mL for 1% gel) into an Erlenmeyer flask. Add 1× TAE or TBE buffer. Swirl
detailedSteps.zh: 称取琼脂糖粉末（如 1% 胶：1 g / 100 mL）放入锥形瓶。加 1× TAE 或 TBE 缓冲液，摇匀

detailedSteps.en: Microwave 1–3 min until agarose is completely dissolved. Watch for boiling over. ⚠️ Loosen cap!
detailedSteps.zh: 微波 1–3 min 至完全溶解，注意防止沸腾溢出。⚠️ 松开瓶盖！

detailedSteps.en: Cool to ~55°C (comfortable to hold). Add DNA stain (0.5 µg/mL EtBr or 1× SYBR Safe). Swirl
detailedSteps.zh: 冷至约 55°C（手可握住）。加 DNA 染料（0.5 µg/mL EtBr 或 1× SYBR Safe）。摇匀

detailedSteps.en: Seal ends of gel tray with tape or gaskets. Place comb(s)
detailedSteps.zh: 用胶带或密封垫密封胶模两端，放置梳子

detailedSteps.en: Pour molten agarose into tray. Pop any bubbles with a pipette tip. Let solidify 20–30 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 将熔化琼脂糖倒入模具，用枪头戳破气泡。室温凝固 20–30 min

detailedSteps.en: Remove comb(s) gently. Place gel in electrophoresis chamber
detailedSteps.zh: 轻轻拔出梳子，将凝胶放入电泳槽

detailedSteps.en: Fill chamber with 1× TAE/TBE until gel is submerged (2–3 mm above gel surface). Use same buffer as gel
detailedSteps.zh: 加 1× TAE/TBE 没过凝胶 2–3 mm。必须与制胶用同一缓冲液

detailedSteps.en: Mix DNA samples with 6× loading dye (1:5 ratio). Load into wells using a micropipette
detailedSteps.zh: 将 DNA 样品与 6× loading dye 1:5 混合。用微量移液器加样

detailedSteps.en: Load DNA ladder in the first and/or last well
detailedSteps.zh: 在第一和/或最后一个孔加入 DNA ladder

detailedSteps.en: Connect power supply. Run at 5–8 V/cm (e.g., 100–120V for standard mini gel) for 30–60 min
detailedSteps.zh: 连接电源。5–8 V/cm 电泳（标准小胶用 100–120V），30–60 min

detailedSteps.en: Monitor: loading dye should travel ⅔–¾ of gel length. Dye migrates toward + (red) electrode
detailedSteps.zh: 观察：loading dye 应跑到凝胶 ⅔–¾ 处。染料向阳极（红色）迁移

detailedSteps.en: Turn off power. Remove gel from tray
detailedSteps.zh: 关闭电源，取出凝胶

detailedSteps.en: Image on UV transilluminator (254/302 nm for EtBr) or blue light (for SYBR Safe). Photograph and document
detailedSteps.zh: 紫外透射仪（EtBr：254/302 nm）或蓝光（SYBR Safe）下成像。拍照记录

detailedSteps.en: Compare band sizes to ladder. **For gel extraction**: use blue light (less DNA damage), cut band with clean scalpel, purify with gel extraction kit
detailedSteps.zh: 对照 ladder 比较条带大小。**胶回收时**: 使用蓝光（减少 DNA 损伤），用干净手术刀切下条带，用胶回收试剂盒纯化

note.zh: 胶回收用低熔点琼脂糖

materials.name: UV transilluminator or blue light imager

usage.en: Gold-standard total RNA extraction using phenol-guanidinium. High yield from cells, tissues, bacteria. Compatible with downstream RT-qPCR, RNA-seq, Northern blot.
usage.zh: 苯酚-异硫氰酸胍法提取总 RNA 的金标准。适用于细胞、组织、细菌。兼容 RT-qPCR、RNA-seq、Northern blot 等下游实验。

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells in TRIzol → add chloroform → centrifuge → collect aqueous phase → isopropanol precipitate → ethanol wash → dissolve RNA
briefSteps.zh: TRIzol 裂解 → 加氯仿 → 离心 → 取水相 → 异丙醇沉淀 → 乙醇洗涤 → 溶解 RNA

detailedSteps.en: **Cell lysis**: Remove media, add 1 mL TRIzol per 5–10×10⁶ cells (or 50–100 mg tissue). Pipet up/down 10× to lyse completely
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞裂解**: 去除培养基，每 5–10×10⁶ 细胞加 1 mL TRIzol（或 50–100 mg 组织）。反复吹打 10 次至完全裂解

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 5 min at RT to dissociate nucleoprotein complexes
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 5 min，使核蛋白复合物完全解离

detailedSteps.en: **Phase separation**: Add 0.2 mL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol. Cap tightly, shake vigorously 15 s (do NOT vortex)
detailedSteps.zh: **相分离**: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加 0.2 mL 氯仿。盖紧管盖，剧烈摇晃 15 s（不要涡旋）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 2–3 min at RT. Solution should turn milky pink
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 2–3 min。溶液应变为乳白粉红色

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 12,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Three layers form: red organic (bottom), white interphase, clear aqueous (top)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 12,000×g 离心 15 min。形成三层：红色有机相（底）、白色中间相、透明水相（顶）

detailedSteps.en: **RNA precipitation**: Carefully transfer upper aqueous phase to new tube (~60% of TRIzol volume). ⚠️ Avoid interphase!
detailedSteps.zh: **RNA 沉淀**: 小心转移上层水相至新管（约为 TRIzol 体积的 60%）。⚠️ 避免触碰中间相！

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL isopropanol per 1 mL TRIzol. Mix gently by inversion 6×
detailedSteps.zh: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加 0.5 mL 异丙醇。轻柔颠倒混匀 6 次

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 10 min RT (or -20°C 1 h for low-abundance samples)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 10 min（低丰度样品可 -20°C 放 1 h）

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 12,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. RNA pellet should be visible (white/translucent)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 12,000×g 离心 10 min。应可见 RNA 沉淀（白色/半透明）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Discard supernatant. Add 1 mL 75% ethanol (in DEPC-H₂O). Vortex briefly
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 弃上清。加 1 mL 75% 乙醇（DEPC 水配制）。短暂涡旋

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 7,500×g, 5 min, 4°C. Discard ethanol completely
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 7,500×g 离心 5 min。完全弃去乙醇

detailedSteps.en: **Dissolve**: Air-dry pellet 5–10 min (do NOT over-dry — pellet becomes hard to dissolve). Dissolve in 20–50 µL RNase-free H₂O
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解**: 室温风干沉淀 5–10 min（不要过度干燥——会难以溶解）。加 20–50 µL 无 RNase 水溶解

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 55°C, 10 min to aid dissolution. Place on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 55°C 孵育 10 min 促进溶解。然后置于冰上

detailedSteps.en: **QC**: Measure A260/280 (expect ~2.0) and A260/230 (expect >1.7). Run on gel or Bioanalyzer if needed
detailedSteps.zh: **质检**: 测 A260/280（期望 ~2.0）和 A260/230（期望 >1.7）。必要时跑胶或 Bioanalyzer 检测

label.zh: 实验方案 — RNA -80°C 保存
